comment: Small-data symbols whose bytes come from reconstructed C rather than the assembled data split.
A claim requires independent source/unit evidence; matching an address alone is not ownership proof.
Entries name symbol, source, section (sdata or sbss), retail address, and symbol size.
Every defined symbol in an owned object section must be enumerated, and the complete section must fill an explicit Splat gap.
tools/data_ownership.py --check validates configuration without compiled objects.
tools/build.py validates fresh ELF symbols, sizes, unique providers, origins, gaps and fragments before placing each whole contribution once in the final linker script.
The full loaded image and PT_LOAD memory extent must still match retail. No new claims are inferred from zero bytes or nearby symbols.
